policy.verified_definition: Primary evidence was opened and inspected. Verified is a limited evidence status, not human identity review, a production identity decision, or a legal-entity assertion.
policy.source_ids_meaning: Related finalized source-inventory entries; these are not actor IDs or proof that a quoted belief belongs to an actor.
policy.type_vocabulary: Preparatory types only. Person/organization candidates still need human review. Teams need actor-type adjudication; model/product labels must not become person actors.
name_rules: Retain original script and exact source spelling.
Names, pinyin, initials and translations are search aids, not identity keys.
A relation other than a name-equivalence relation must not be imported as an alias.
Unverified search variants and unresolved test strings must not enter verified production aliases.
Language does not establish nationality, location or jurisdiction.
Record source-time affiliations separately from the page-access date.
Corporate brand, legal operator, team, product, model family, checkpoint, API alias and person are different entity levels.
policy.evidence_scope: Only minimal names, bibliographic links and original paraphrases retained. No full article text, secrets or contact data. Access date does not establish a release date, current-model status or complete organizational history.
normalization_limits: Unicode/whitespace normalization may aid search, but retain the observed spelling.
Simplified/traditional conversion, surname-first order, acronym expansion and pinyin variants require occurrence-specific review.
Do not infer affiliation dates from undated live pages.
policy.actor_type_representable_meaning: Schema type compatibility only: true means the preparatory person/organization category can be represented by a frozen actor kind after separate adjudication. It does not approve identity, merging, source attribution, rights, publication or production admission. A model/product/team relation cannot be flattened into actor aliases.
